characters.name: Cerol Hunter · Grunt feminino
characters.identity: Young adult woman, medium BROWN skin, cool brown narrow eyes, compact straight chin-length BLACK BOB with angular longer side locks. A narrow ivory headwrap runs across forehead and around nape, leaving whole face and both eyes visible. Alert and cocky rather than goofy. The standard team uniform: fitted but not sexualized short BLACK work jacket with offset folded collar, charcoal undershirt, same cut-kite crest on anatomical LEFT chest and larger upper back. Full length tapered CHARCOAL trousers, practical small black ankle boots. Bone cloth wrapping on anatomical LEFT forearm only (viewerRIGHT front, viewerLEFT back), and one short wrap around RIGHT calf over trousers. Two narrow attached linen ends hang only12cm from that forearm, not a long scarf. Belt supports a small bandage-wrapped kite reel at anatomical RIGHT hip, consistent front/back. Fingerless dark gloves. Her bob silhouette and slight sideways stance distinguish her from male grunt. No miniskirt, no bare midriff, no heels. Handwritten title 'Cerol Hunter' and small subtitle 'Grunt feminino'.

Plain white background, no cast shadow, no scenery or extra people. Small handwritten name top-left only. TEAM DESIGN invariant: CEROL HUNTERS, a fictional kite-stealing rival team, original costume grammar. Matte INK BLACK clothes with charcoal panels clearly separated into two dark values, warm BONE IVORY mummy-like textile wraps, a very small tarnished brass clasp/accent. The wrappings are clean old cloth integrated into clothing, no wounds or gore. A few short cloth ends behave like kite tails, physically attached to seams; never floating. Team crest repeated consistently: one BONE WHITE KITE DIAMOND split by a single diagonal black slash, two little downward tail marks; simple geometric emblem, NOT a letter R or an existing franchise logo. Emblem on upper chest and upper back. Clothing readable, not covered in random straps. Visible black-to-charcoal value differences maintain body readability. No combat weapon. characters.name: Ronne
characters.identity: Male TEAM LEADER Ronne, around32, tall lean adult with long angular face, warm BROWN skin, pale muted olive narrow eyes, sharp drawn brows, restrained arrogant smile. Black hair swept backwards into ONE high folded-kite shaped crest with a thin ash-grey streak at anatomical LEFT temple. Unique silhouette: long INK BLACK sleeveless-tailored overcoat with angular high folded collar and two pointed kite-tail coat panels, over charcoal fitted long-sleeve shirt and straight charcoal trousers. Coat panels connect to coat waist, not floating. Anatomical RIGHT forearm wrapped in BONE IVORY linen above dark glove, with one long30cm linen end pinned under upper-arm clasp; LEFT sleeve plain charcoal with small brass cuff clasp. One broad diagonal mummy cloth sash from anatomical LEFT shoulder to RIGHT waist passes UNDER coat lapels; do not wrap all body. Team cut-kite crest at LEFT upper chest and larger back. A small bandage-wrapped kite reel clipped at RIGHT hip, practical slim black boots. Different from a generic gothic vampire: no spikes, red lining, capes, fangs or weapons; he is a calculating kite-team leader. Preserve hair streak, sash and wrapped arm anatomical sides from back. Both eyes/face entirely visible. Handwritten title 'Ronne'.

characters.name: Malvadocia
characters.identity: Female TEAM LEADER Malvadocia, around40, tall commanding adult woman with warm light-brown skin, narrow muted plum eyes, long sharp gentle angular jaw, thin arched eyebrows and a small calculating closed-lip smirk. Clearly mature, not a teen. STRIKING BLACK HAIR with a broad BONE WHITE front wedge at anatomical RIGHT fringe; sleek geometric shoulder-length cut, inward-pointed ends, back silhouette like an inverted kite diamond. A thin ivory cloth band wraps under rear hair at nape, not around eyes. Clothing: architecturally simple long BLACK tailored coat with a broad asymmetric folded collar, two angular outward panels at shoulders shaped like folded PAPER (soft cloth not armor), fitted charcoal high-neck underlayer, high-waisted wide black ankle-length culottes and practical low black boots. One BONE IVORY mummy band winds across anatomical LEFT shoulder, over collar, and down LEFT upper sleeve, ending secured at left forearm, with TWO neatly attached short linen tail strips. RIGHT arm plain black, one brass cuff. Dark fingerless gloves, small wrapped reel at LEFT hip, cut-kite crest on upper chest and larger back. Strong broad collar against narrow waist and wide culottes makes silhouette completely different from Ronne's tall straight coat. No cleavage, corset, heels, gothic lace, jewelry pile or witch hat. Both eyes and face fully visible. Keep white hair wedge and wrapped sleeve anatomical sides consistent front/back. Handwritten title 'Malvadocia'.
